{{Quote|I've been in charge of the Guild Museum and Library for a long time, and, over the years more than a few young hunters have told me that they little interest in history, that they were more interested in the present and moments yet to come.|Weeyo's opening to his section of ''The Bounty Hunters' Code|<ref name="BHC" />}}
The title of '''Chief Custodian''' was one given by the [[Bounty Hunters' Guild/Legends|Bounty Hunters' Guild]] to the individual who was placed in charge of the [[Bounty Hunters Guild Museum and Library]]. The [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Kenek Weeyo]] held the role for many [[Standard year/Legends|years]], and contributed a chapter to the Guild's member [[Book/Legends|handbook]] ''[[The Bounty Hunter Code]]'' at some point after the [[Order 66/Legends|fall]] of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]].<ref name="BHC" />

==Behind the scenes==
The title of Chief Custodian was first mentioned in the [[2014]] reference book, ''[[The Bounty Hunter Code: From the Files of Boba Fett]]'' which was written by [[Daniel Wallace]], [[Jason Fry]] and [[Ryder Windham]].
